Thanks to @NYSBroadcasters & representatives from NY-18 stations for making the trip to DC to discuss everything from the importance of local broadcasting & journalism to concerns about artificial intelligence.

Looking forward to more productive conversations! https://t.co/GwR5VKtB0U

The war in Ukraine has shown us that investments in data, AI and compute are what's going to allow us to stay ahead of the curve in a future conflict. How are you thinking about taking a more data-driven and AI-enabled posture in SOUTHCOM? [...] SOUTHCOM continues to lean forward as an experimentation hub for emerging technologies and is actively leveraging and pursuing Artificial Learning and Machine Learning (AL/ML) for improved data management, analytics, and dissemination.

Using AI to decide which seniors get the healthcare they need & who's out of luck while funneling record-breaking profits to healthcare monopolies?

That’s a big no from me & is why I joined colleagues on a letter to demand that CMS end this plan immediately. https://t.co/pPLbeKq52K

Battle lines are being drawn.

On one side are the American people, sick of an economy rigged against them.

On the other, AI oligarchs who will stop at nothing to get even richer.

They're spending millions to destroy @AlexBores.

That means its time to get a whole lot louder. https://t.co/aBUwz42nV7

AI will bring the biggest economic and social transformation of our lifetime, and the battle lines are being drawn. On one side are a handful of tech oligarchs who will stop at nothing in the quest to make trillions and grow their own power. On the other side are the American people; hard-working folks sick of an economy rigged against them, and worried about what this AI transformation will mean for their families.
A handful of the richest people in the history of the world are spending millions to defeat him because they’re terrified of a true leader with the courage and the expertise to take them on.

This should have been a moment for all of us to work together and keep our kids safe online. Instead, Big Tech and their army of lobbyists hijacked and watered down what was previously a common-sense bipartisan bill.
Without a duty of care provision, the KIDS Act gives Big Tech a free pass to keep putting profits over the safety of our kids.

Agree. 

The stakes are far too high for a few CEOs and whoever has the President’s ear that day to decide behind closed doors what counts as safe -- or who wins and loses from the AI transition.

Congress needs public hearings. The American people deserve answers. https://t.co/rSKEjfUXAw

When your AI hacks another company, you don’t get to be the only one investigating what happened.

We need public hearings to get real answers on what happened at Open AI and Anthropic. https://t.co/oB9rcTWOku

No, people hate data centers b/c Trump wants to let the richest, most powerful companies do whatever they want, wherever they want at YOUR expense.

The same companies who don't care if AI takes your job or if their models hack other companies.

All they care about is profit. https://t.co/JtHvsOCILW

When I wrote a letter with @GregCasar to OpenAI last month (post Hugging Face), we asked whether other similar incidents had occurred. 

They refused to tell us. Then this comes out. 

The House Democratic Majority arrives in January. 

I look forward to the public hearings. https://t.co/TNr8N1AKbf

1) We need emergency hearings on pacing the frontier – NOW!!

2) This November, we need to elect leaders willing to stand up to AI oligarchs and fight for the American people. 

Trump wants to let billionaires who only care about ego & profit run our country. 

We will stop them. https://t.co/4iF0MbcyU4

Feels like a good time to remind people that our President, at the behest of his billionaire donors, instituted a voluntary and completely secret process for approving AI models. 

It’s profit for the .01% first, safety and economic prosperity for the American people last.

Trump is worse than asleep at the wheel — he's actively selling the American people out to his billionaire buddies. 

He doesn’t care about job loss, cybercrime, or existential risk. His only motivation is profit. 

We need Patriots who fight for the people, not the AI oligarchs. https://t.co/J7QMzBf2cO

Trump: "We can't let China win the AI race!"

Also, Trump: Gives China the exact chips they need to build the most advanced AI https://t.co/y8cdAYU0tR

The billionaires behind Leading the Future only care about one thing: their own profits.

Not AI taking our jobs, destroying our water supplies, or committing felony-level cybercrime.

We won’t let a handful of the richest people in history silence us.

Proud to join this fight💪 https://t.co/3AqTlkzvIi

Want to know why I don't trust labs to police themselves?

Because this keeps happening, and it's always a third-party figuring it out!

Yet when Congress asks OpenAI/Anthropic about security incidents, we get stonewalled.

We need embedded independent auditors. And subpoenas. https://t.co/tC6TmveAqt

Is nothing sacred anymore..?! 

McDonald's is using AI and their access to data from millions of customers to charge you more for a Big Mac. 

The DOJ should investigate this pricing scheme IMMEDIATELY. https://t.co/WOgIQMTi97

I’m so proud that here in the Hudson Valley we’re standing together and fighting back against these data center projects. We’re not going to let anyone — especially not a bunch of billionaire tech oligarchs — come in here and poison our water, drive up our utility bills, and build this powerful technology that even they acknowledge could have devastating impacts for humankind.
We need to slow it down [...] We need to pump the brakes because there’s a lot of risk.
They jack up utility bills that are already too high. They poison our water.
Whether you’re a president breaking the law, a billionaire influencing our elections, or a tech oligarch unleashing dangerous AI into our communities, NO ONE is above the law. https://t.co/zhhl4tjLhU
I have real concerns...It would be like saying, 'Do you want someone to come build a nuclear weapon in your neighborhood if they're willing to pay for it?' No
